name: std/math
description: Numeric core: fixed/arbitrary number types (Nbr*), base real/complex math (Math, Math32/64/L), RNG. Advanced/special functions live in std/numerics.
residual: FoxArrayBase and FoxArrayBaseOptimized are the RUNTIME of math arrays: code the compiler generates calls them, no source names them. They live here rather than in std/compiler because their subject is arithmetic. FoxArrayBaseOptimized is x86 kernels and does not exist on AArch64; FoxArrayBase loads it by name if it is there.
